name: Hyperstudio
mood: Obsidian editorial-tech studio with sharp grid panels, white pill actions, one compass-gold accent, and a tiny pulse-green status signal.

obsidian.role: Primary page background and deepest surface layer.

deepNavy.role: Slightly cooler dark surface for section depth.

steelInk.role: Alternative black panel surface and footer base.

paper.role: Primary text, CTA fill, and high-contrast strokes.

mutedWhite.role: Secondary text and softer paragraph copy.

softWhite.role: Tertiary copy, footer links, and inactive nav.

faintLine.role: Hairline borders and grid panel dividers.

translucentWhite.role: Subtle separators and hover or focus borders.

compassGold.role: Compass icon strokes, small AI marks, and restrained illustrative details.

pulseGreen.role: Tiny status dots and live or available signals only.

families.aeonikFallback: Inter, Neue Haas Grotesk, Satoshi, ui-sans-serif, system-ui

rules: Use Aeonik-style type as the sole UI and editorial typeface.
Use weight 400 for headings and body.
Use weight 500 only for CTAs, nav emphasis, and form labels.
Use -0.0200em tracking on headings and -0.0100em on body.

deepNavyBand.role: Section depth and secondary dark surfaces.

steelInkPanel.role: Dark card, input, and footer surfaces.

rules: Do not use gradients or glow effects.
Use hairline grids, dark surface shifts, and type scale for depth.

components.name: Primary Pill CTA
components.recipe: Paper fill, Obsidian text, Aeonik 14px weight 500, 9999px radius, 10px by 18px padding, no shadow.

components.name: Bordered Grid Card
components.recipe: Transparent or Deep Navy fill, 0px radius, 1px Faint Line border, 36-48px padding, no shadow.

components.name: Signal Dot
components.recipe: 6-8px Pulse Green circle, used sparingly for active status.

components.name: Service Accordion Item
components.recipe: Full-width row with 1px Faint Line divider, 24-30px label, muted body preview, plus icon or arrow right.

components.name: Email Input
components.recipe: Transparent or Steel Ink background, Paper text, 1px Faint Line border, 9999px radius, 14px text, 12px by 18px padding.

do: Use near-black backgrounds and white alpha borders.
Keep cards and grid panels square-edged.
Use pill radius only for buttons and inputs.
Use Compass Gold only for icons and tiny marks.
Use Pulse Green only for status dots.
Separate sections with hairline borders and grid lines.
dont: Do not add gradients, glow effects, or glassmorphism.
Do not use gold as a CTA fill.
Do not turn green into a broad accent color.
Do not introduce extra accent colors.
Do not make the layout image-heavy.

imagery.style: Abstract technical motifs, compass marks, monoline icons, partner wordmarks, and schematic UI fragments.
rules: Avoid large screenshots and decorative gradients.
Use Compass Gold for small icon strokes only.

layout.hero: Text-led dark hero with display headline, pill CTA, and optional tiny status dot.
layout.sections: Full-width dark bands separated by Faint Line borders and 96px gaps.
layout.grids: Square bordered panels with 0px radius and 36-48px padding.
layout.nav: Transparent dark header with ghost links and a white pill CTA.

preview.note: Refero exposes preview imagery, but local download was not captured in this environment.
